title: Can or Can't
sourceText: I can’t knit. Cats can’t write. Fish can’t blink.
Dogs can’t dance. Ants can’t read. Crows can’t sing.
Crows can caw. Ants can bite. Dogs can bark!
Pigs can eat. Fish can swim. Cats can jump. And I can read!
scoringNotes: Binary picture choices aggregate correct can/can’t assignments.
The can’t spelling item gives equal credit to each character in the correct position.
Selected distractors may carry provisional 67/33/0 diagnostic weights.
